title: Reading Drill — Mapping an old village well — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Mapping an old village well — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The heritage researcher in Bramley received an old report about different records placing the well on opposite sides of a road. The report compared the distance between recorded positions, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the historic surveys rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered ten weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include changes in the name of the road. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a matched overlay of field maps as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
